summary: Human Response is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in coordinated humanitarian response, health and displacement. Semester one is at Iscte in Lisbon, semester two at NTNU in Norway and semester three at Makerere University in Uganda, with partners in Cape Verde, Mozambique and Greece. Fifteen scholarships per edition pay €1,400 a month with no fees. The scholarship round closes on 7 January 2027.

€1,400 a month. There are no other payments.
eligibility: English: TOEFL iBT 92, IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 5.5), PTE Academic 76, Cambridge C1 or C2 at 180, or Duolingo 135.

No test is needed if you finished secondary school in a country where English is the official language, such as Ghana, or if your whole bachelor's was taught in English and your registrar confirms it.
how_to_apply: Create an account on Iscte's application portal and apply for the 2027–2029 edition.

Upload your passport, photo, diplomas, transcripts, English certificate or exemption, CV, statement of purpose and two signed, dated recommendation letters. A missing document makes the application ineligible.
Submit before the scholarship round ends on 7 January 2027.
Applications are scored on academic level (30%), relevance of your degree (15%), research (5%), professional experience (20%), statement of purpose (20%) and fit with the programme (10%).
watch_out: The allowance starts three weeks to a month after you arrive in Lisbon, so bring enough to live on until then.
Anyone who has held an Erasmus Mundus scholarship before cannot get another.
